contract: The page must expose window.app.state() returning an object whose color is the light's current colour.

steps.name: loads with no page or console error, showing red
a key press advances the light to amber
the next press advances it to green
the next press cycles back to red
pressing r sets the light straight to red
pressing r again leaves it red
after r, the cycling keys still work
no page or console error was raised at any point
